title: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sents.t: A father takes his wife and child to a theme park and, while recording them, captures something pretty creepy.
sents.zh: 一位父亲带着妻子和孩子去游乐园，在给她们拍视频时，拍到了相当诡异的东西。

sents.t: The father states that after coming back from the theme park, his daughter told them that she was scared of going back.
sents.zh: 父亲说，从游乐园回来后，女儿告诉他们，她害怕再去那里。

sents.t: But it wasn't because she was afraid of the rides, but because of something else.
sents.zh: 但不是因为她怕那些游乐设施，而是因为别的东西。

sents.t: It was only after looking back at the footage he took that he understood why his daughter was so afraid.
sents.zh: 直到回看自己拍的视频，他才明白女儿为什么那么害怕。

sents.t: Be sure to look closely, or you'll miss it.
sents.zh: 一定要仔细看，不然就错过了。

sents.t: Right behind his daughter, there appears to be a hand coming out of nowhere.
sents.zh: 就在他女儿身后，好像凭空伸出了一只手。

sents.t: The scariest part about this, though, is the fact that it seems to be reaching out to her.
sents.zh: 不过最吓人的是，那只手好像正伸向她。

sents.t: But something else was caught on camera that also went unnoticed.
sents.zh: 但镜头还拍到了另一样同样没人注意到的东西。

sents.t: Earlier in the video, the father is recording a boat that's passing by when, out of nowhere, he captures this.
sents.zh: 在视频前面，父亲正在拍一艘经过的船，突然，他拍到了这个。

sents.t: I honestly have no explanation for this, but I have plenty of questions.
sents.zh: 说实话，我解释不了这个，但我有一大堆疑问。

sents.t: I can't help but think that this might have been the same hand that appears later on.
sents.zh: 我忍不住觉得，这可能就是后面出现的那只手。

sents.t: But what's even more creepy about this is that it seems to be trying to get the father's attention.
sents.zh: 但更吓人的是，它好像在试图引起父亲的注意。

sents.t: Or could it be that it was trying to get the daughter's?
sents.zh: 还是说，它想引起的是女儿的注意？

sents.t: There has yet to be an explanation for this, but as always, what are your thoughts?
sents.zh: 这件事至今没有解释，和往常一样，你怎么看？
